environment.evidence: No managed-cloud marker detected; OS alone does not prove local/cloud execution

configuration.network_condition: Loopback WebSocket relay with optional fixed delay and payload serialization time before each endpoint send. This is not observed LAN/WAN latency.
configuration.message_aead_method: AES-256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 measured in independent confirmed sessions. Timings include the message ratchet and serialization.
configuration.rekey_method: Fresh four-flight authenticated handshake between the same pinned identities; new session ID verified.
configuration.network_delay_model: Each four-flight handshake/re-key has four injected delays; each message/opaque roundtrip has two.

metadata.conditions: Sequential trials; one unrecorded primitive warm-up and, when supplied, one unrecorded full protocol/network callback warm-up per algorithm. Network metrics come only from actual callback exchanges.
metadata.memory_method: RSS sampled after each operation; resource.ru_maxrss cumulative process high-water mark; tracemalloc Python-allocation peak. High-water marks are process-wide and not attributable to one algorithm.
metadata.cpu_method: process_time_ns includes all process threads; CPU usage percent = process CPU / wall time, may exceed 100%.
metadata.status_note: HQC-3 is experimental; default application policy does not select it.

limitations: RSS samples are not a continuous peak-native-memory profiler.

No network transmission latency is inferred from cryptographic computation timings.

HQC-3: 30 measured trials; mean KEM computation 10.5867 ms.
